title: Independent discovery of halogen-dependent band gaps in pyridinium lead bromides
difficulty_reasons: The agent must choose and defend the computational and relativistic model.
It must independently formulate and discriminate structural/orbital explanations while validating three heavy-element periodic systems.

data.description: Supplied immutable CCDC 2499860/2499862/2499861 CIFs for the Cl/Br/I 300 K P21/c crystals; database retrieval is not scored.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable per-crystal validated gaps, band-edge evidence, independently reasoned explanation and limitations.
